lead_raw_text:
The structure of composition Sm₆Al₂ (reduced formula Sm₃Al) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4₁/amd (No. 143), with eight atoms per unit cell distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows both Al and Sm centers have 12 geometric neighbors in close-packed-like local arrangements, with Al surrounded by 8 Al and 4 Sm neighbors, and Sm surrounded by 4 Al and 8 Sm neighbors, at distances of 3.1625–3.2482 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all eight sites, and validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among 12-vertex Al and Sm coordination polyhedra.
